title: Intervention Traceability Row
description: One row in is_intervention_traceability.csv. Decision audit trail linking each bioproject's is_intervention classification back to paper evidence. Output of Phase 5.

paper_pmcid.description: PMC ID of paper used for classification

key_design_finding.description: Key design finding from the paper that drove the classification

is_intervention_yes.description: Description of which sample groups/timepoints are is_intervention=yes and why

is_intervention_no.description: Description of which sample groups/timepoints are is_intervention=no and why

is_intervention_unknown.description: Description of which sample groups/timepoints could not be classified

evidence_quality.description: How reliable is the underlying paper evidence?
